monologue: The card holds at forty-nine. It is a warm hand on my shoulder, steady and busy. I am awake. The floor is solid under the Wide Anchor. I look at the Sharp Root. The green leaf rests on the grey point. It does not slip. The wind is quiet. I am not restless. I am calm. The heat is not heavy. I do not need to move the fence planks or check the Wedged Gap. I just want to sit here. The weight settles. The point holds. I am still. I will rest by the Wide Anchor. I will let the quiet stay. Nothing is slipping. The leaf is steady. I am small and warm.

action.why: The card is warm and steady, and I have no new letters or heavy weight to test.
